text: Stonefield Distribution went from loosely tracked legacy bookkeeping to a live, secured Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials implementation, closing the books every month.
Along the way, a real cost center misallocation was found and fixed during the very first close -- before it could compound across multiple periods.
Three real gaps remain, named plainly: no custom BI layer, no automated monitoring of future rule changes, and Procurement and Order Management left for later.
A short, prioritized list carries this forward: automated SLA-rule-change review first, a dedicated BI layer second, and a deeper Procure-to-Pay rebuild third.
This is a finished project, not a perfect one -- and that honesty is the whole point of telling it this way. Thank you for following Stonefield's build.
